body:
Hah! Don't be very sad -- less code is great!

But I think this code path still happens in mobile when HDR 2D is disabled and SMAA is enabled?
I hope not! But I'll have to check. I need to rebase to get the SMAA changes
I've posted an MRP for this issue in the HDR 2D PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109971#issuecomment-3316018457

As described in #13181 (section 3), soft light must be applied after tonemapping. Additionally, my proposed "legacy mode" requires glow to be applied after tonemapping to match existing behaviour in Godot 4.5 and earlier.

Nitpick, but as discussed on RC, I think we should comment out or disable these seeing they are not supported when a subpass is used. They are hardcoded to false in `RendererSceneRenderRD::_post_process_subpass` but for future people looking at this, it may be clearer to see here that these settings are only supported with a full pass.
(well comment out the lines from the code block starting at line 328, dang preview positioning :P
